blocks.text: Inheritance (wirasat, yani baap se bete ko milne wali cheezein) mein ek class doosri class ke attributes aur methods le leti hai. Is se code reuse hota hai (dobara istemal hota hai) aur classes mein hierarchical (oopar-neeche, khandan jaisa) relationship banta hai: Animal parent hai, Dog aur Cat us ki subclasses.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"class Animal:": parent (bari) class.
"def make_sound(self): print("Animal sound")": method ki sirf ek line ho to woh colon ke baad usi line par likhi ja sakti hai; yeh "Animal sound" print karta hai.
"class Dog(Animal):": Dog class bracket mein Animal likhne se Animal se inherit karti hai (us ki cheezein wirasat mein leti hai).
"def make_sound(self):" aur "print("Bark!")": Dog make_sound ka apna version likhti hai; is ko method overriding (parent ka method apne tareeqe se dobara likhna) kehte hain.
"class Cat(Animal):": Cat bhi Animal se inherit karti hai aur "Meow ! " print karti hai (kitab ki spacing ke saath).
Yahan sirf classes define hui hain; koi object nahi bana aur method bulaya nahi gaya, is liye chalane par kuch print nahi hota. Misaal: Dog().make_sound() likhne se "Bark!" aayega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Dog aur Cat classes ko bina indentation ke chhapti hai; aise IndentationError aata hai. def make_sound class ke andar aur print() def ke andar indented hona chahiye, jaise oopar.

blocks.explanation: "Animal sound": base class apna version rakhti hai.

blocks.text: Dog class mein introduce() method likha hi nahi, phir bhi woh Animal se inherit ho kar (wirasat mein mil kar) chalta hai, jabke make_sound() Dog ka apna hai. pet_name badal kar Run karein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"pet_name = "Moti"": paltu janwar ka naam.
"class Animal:": is mein __init__ (naam rakhta hai), introduce() (naam batata hai) aur make_sound() hain.
"class Dog(Animal):": Dog Animal se inherit karti hai aur sirf make_sound() apna likhti hai ("Bark!").
"pet = Dog(pet_name)": Dog ka apna __init__ nahi, is liye Animal wala __init__ chalta hai aur naam rakhta hai.
"pet.introduce()": Dog mein yeh method nahi, magar Animal se wirasat mein mila hai: "My name is Moti".
"pet.make_sound()": Dog ka apna method chalta hai, Animal wala nahi: "Bark!".
Output: "My name is Moti" aur "Bark!".
Khud try karein: pet_name = "Sheru" kar ke Run karein: "My name is Sheru" aayega; doosri line "Bark!" hi rahegi.

items: class Dog(Animal): Dog, Animal ke attributes aur methods inherit karti hai (wirasat mein leti hai).
Override: subclass method apne tareeqe se likhti hai.
